shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --stat | head -50; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -o '"@gravity-ui/icons"[^,]*' package.json; ls build/esm/components/controls build/esm/components/layout; cat build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls build/esm/components/Avatar build/esm/components/Avatar/types

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; sed -n 1,200p Select/types.d.ts | grep -nE '^\s+(value|options|onUpdate|filterable|label|errorMessage|validationState|id|width|placeholder|hasClear|renderOption|size|name|title|controlProps|getOptionHeight)\??:' ; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; ls ../hooks 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "useFileInput" ../hooks/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts; cat components/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p; grep -n "export" components/index.d.ts | head -80; ls components/Checkbox components/layout/Flex; sed -n 1,40p components/Text/Text.d.ts; sed -n 1,60p components/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -E "view|loading|type|extraProps"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 60,115p Select/types.d.ts; grep -n "aria\|onUpdate\|value" Select/types.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,40p Alert/types.d.ts | grep -E "^\s+\w+\??:"; grep -E "^\s+\w+\??:" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "supportedValuesOf" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/typescript/lib/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/typescript/lib | head; grep -n "type?" Button/Button.d.ts

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|testing-library|happy-dom"

sed -i "s#appType: 'custom', logLevel: 'error'#appType: 'custom', logLevel: 'error', ssr: { noExternal: ['@gravity-ui/uikit'] }#" /tmp/ssrcheck/check.mjs && node /tmp/ssrcheck/check.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -25

sed -i "s/const sign = minutes < 0 ? '−' : '+';/const sign = minutes < 0 ? '-' : '+';/" src/ProfileSettings/options.ts && sed -i 's/filterPlaceholder="Поиск: город или UTC+3"/filterPlaceholder="Поиск: Moscow, UTC+03"/' src/ProfileSettings/ProfileSettings.tsx && grep -n "const sign = minutes\|filterPlaceholder" src/ProfileSettings/*.ts* && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && rm -rf dist /tmp/ssrcheck && git status --short
